This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on 
an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The technical specification of the oil pump : 
capacity Q:8.3-151/s, total head H: 27-34.8m, speed n:2900 rpm, power 7kw

The first draft is initiated by Atef Sadek Sayed, 
reviewed by eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr,
accepted by Pre.general director eng. Ahmed 
Saber Gabr, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of 
High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.

Wear safety equipment as 
 safety helmet , shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc

items:
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety equipment as 
 safety helmet , shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off Pump
Use suitable warning boards
Set of common and special tools
Spare parts, gaskets and rubber
Kerosene and cleaning material (rag. cloth)
Packing and grease

To carry out the outside inspection & to hear the pump in 
 operation before stoppage for the revision for the purpose of normal operation 
 of the bearings, vibrations, and leakage through the sealing joints

When stripping a pump, inspect all the parts as to determine 
 whether individual parts are fit for further service, whether they should be 
 replaced or subjected to repair
Begin stripping a pump by detaching the pipe line
Remove the pump housing cover & the impeller
Strip the sealing gland
Remove the pump housing from its bracket

Take off the bearing housing caps with a drift knock out the 
 ball bearing and shaft
Take the ball bearing off the pump shaft

Having inspected, repair or replaced parts, as required, begin 
 assembly of the pump in reverse steps of stripping
Before assembly, flush all parts and wipe them dry

Having assembled the pump, back grease into the ball bearing 
 housing
Run the pump and check for the proper operation
